profile.title: Shared pulmonary axial advection-diffusion-reaction verification case

validity.population: software cross-resolution verification bound to the M4.7 equivalent pulmonary capillary geometry
validity.physiological_state: healthy-adult resting supine capillary context; synthetic local tracer and reaction kinetics
validity.description: An infinite-line analytical solution, deterministic endpoint particles, and conservative one-dimensional finite volumes share axial flow, diffusion, bulk reaction, and a cylindrical surface-to-volume wall sink.

limitations: The equivalent cylindrical lumen is evidence-bound through M4.7 but is not an anatomical alveolar-sheet reconstruction.
The model is cross-section averaged; wall interaction is a homogeneous sink k_wall = 2 v_wall / radius rather than an explicit radial encounter or receptor-binding process.
The molecular diffusivity, bulk reaction rate, and wall interaction velocity are synthetic software fixtures and are not qualified pulmonary kinetics.
The analytical reference assumes an infinite axial line; finite-volume boundary escape is therefore separately bounded and required to remain negligible.
The microscopic result samples exact final positions and competing reaction outcomes rather than resolving intermediate particle-wall trajectories.
